scope: Independent read-only source, exact-diff/AST, sealed-map binding, existing narrow-control evidence, and metadata-only disk-budget review. Only this peer report was added; no reviewed source or evidence was modified.

source_and_ast.sole_execution_substitution: Rebuild uses the unchanged canonical public builder authenticated by the sealed full copy map instead of requiring a builder inside the frozen selected members.

preserved_security_and_replay_requiremen: Full map has its own required caller-supplied sealed SHA256; strict parse and validated_map run before unique builder binding.
Builder expected bytes, logical descriptor, canonical descriptor, exact integer byte counts and byte_exact mode are checked; canonical bytes use the unchanged FD-safe read_exact reader.
Existing staging-map and selection SHA256 checks, exact row equality, new-control flag and both CSV exclusions are unchanged.
Source pins, one-CPU normal-parent precondition, fresh private output and public/private non-overlap checks remain unchanged.
Original builder make_archive creates the original deterministic USTAR/XZ profile from the exact sorted selected member list; generic decoded-byte limit remains 536870912.
Original verifier validates the entire index, XZ stream and every USTAR member before FD-relative extraction into a new directory. Normal and optimized child modes remain required.
Complete regular-file path-set equality, byte counts and SHA256 are checked after restore, after each mode extraction, and again for the staged tree.
Each rebuild runs the pinned original builder with the extracted tree and original index. Archive byte-for-byte equality and tar SHA256 equality remain mandatory for both modes.
The entire child-runtime verification function is AST-identical: actual optimization mode, one-CPU affinity, interpreter, target digest, arguments, return code and passed status remain checked.
Public maps and selection, selected canonical source bytes, all pinned tool bytes, wrapper bytes, archive and index are rechecked before the replay report is emitted.
Security checks use explicit exceptions rather than assert; optimization does not remove them.

existing_narrow_controls_review.method: Read existing result JSON, exit records and stderr; inspect their pinned test source. These controls were not rerun and this review does not independently attest their process execution.
existing_narrow_controls_review.coverage: Explicit logical builder and same-byte alias acceptance; missing/ambiguous logical or canonical binding; wrong hashes, byte counts, boolean counts or mode; changed actual builder bytes; exact source/AST drift; verifier pin, generic limit, CSV guard and runtime-mode mutation rejection; explicit need under optimization.

disk_budget.scope: Disk-space estimate only. No archive fixture payloads were read or decompressed to establish it. Shared free space must be checked again immediately before execution.

execution_prerequisites: Pin this reviewed wrapper and the exact full-map, staging-map and selection hashes listed here.
Use author/qa/tools/build_controls_archive.py as the explicit builder logical member.
Use capture_process.py with the listed original capture-source SHA256 and BOOT, not a differently named or differently pinned capture wrapper.
Caller retains the single shared exclusive heavy-work lock, with no nested competing lock, and pins the normal parent to one allowed CPU.
Recheck available disk space against peak plus reserve and choose a fresh private output outside the public tree.
Allow no concurrent mutation of public inputs, tools or private replay output during execution.
